subject: Panel debrief: Arjun Verma — final calibration & rank ordering
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: Sarah Huang <sarah@greenleaftalent.com>
Date: Sat, 07 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0000
Subject: Panel debrief: Arjun Verma — final calibration & rank ordering

Team — thanks again for taking the time to interview Arjun this week. Quick ask: please upload your scorecards and 1–2 bullets on the candidate's strongest signals and biggest risks by EOD Monday (11/9). I attached my scorecard and a short rubric note so we're aligned on scales.

Guiding questions for your notes:
- Does Arjun meet bar for Senior Infra (scaling + ops ownership)?
- Any gaps in distributed systems or ownership mentality we should remedy with onboarding?
- How would you rank them vs. other current finalists on a 1–5 final rank?

I'll synthesize and propose an ordering plus recommended next step (hire / hire with caution / no hire). If we have split views, we should hold a quick 20m calibration call before escalating to hiring committee.

Attachments: arjun_verma_scorecard_karthik.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Staff Recruiting Partner (Hiring Lead)
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Panel debrief: Arjun Verma — final calibration & rank ordering

Karthik / all — uploaded my scorecard to the doc and pasted quick notes below.

Score: 4/5 (recommend hire)
Strengths:
- Clear ownership examples: led ops migration for a 60-node cluster with 30% cost reduction
- Thoughtful troubleshooting; asks the right monitoring/SLI questions
Concerns:
- Some gaps on advanced consensus algorithms (limited exposure to Raft at scale)
- Slightly lighter on infra design docs; would want a short onboarding project to pair on design patterns

TL;DR: Strong candidate for Senior Infra. Rank: 2/5 (1 = top).

Lauren
Sr. Eng, Infra
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 12:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Panel debrief: Arjun Verma — final calibration & rank ordering

Adding my scorecard and a slightly longer framing. Copying the rubric quote so the panel can see where I landed.

Score: 3/5 (borderline hire)
Notes:
- Strengths: operational sense, good incident examples, comfortable with automation (Terraform + internal tooling)
- Risks: design tradeoffs were sometimes pragmatic but lacked depth on fault-tolerance choices for geo-replication; on a few design prompts they defaulted to "retry" vs. deeper partition strategies
- Culture fit: very collaborative in the interview; good mentor signals.

I framed some of my feedback against the rubric Karthik attached — if we weight production ownership over deep algorithmic distributed systems, I move them up. If we require immediate mastery of consensus/replication theory, I lean hire-with-caution.

Marissa
Principal Engineer, Platform

> On Sun, 08 Nov 2026 at 09:04, Lauren Bishop wrote:
> > Score: 4/5 (recommend hire)
> > TL;DR: Strong candidate for Senior Infra. Rank: 2/5 (1 = top).
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 17:37:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Panel debrief: Arjun Verma — final calibration & rank ordering

Karthik — uploaded my scorecard and flagged one major concern.

Score: 2/5 (do not hire / needs senior mentor)
Key concern:
- During the systems design exercise Arjun suggested a leader-election approach that did not handle leader churn well; when pressed, answers relied on manual intervention rather than automated reconciliation. In a production infra role that worries me; we have limited tolerance for workarounds that increase toil.

That said, they are excellent in incident triage and documentation. If the hiring bar allows training, this would be a conditional hire with a strong onboarding mentorship plan.

If we can't agree on bar, we should run a 20m sync tomorrow 11/9 at 10am PT. I think Marissa + Lauren + Karthik should join.

Mina
Engineering Manager, Reliability
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 08:01:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Panel debrief: Arjun Verma — final calibration & rank ordering

Thanks everyone — I consolidated the scorecards and pulled out the main splits (attached summary). Proposal below:

Proposed ordering (final rank, 1 = top):
1) Candidate A (internal finalist)
2) Arjun Verma — hire with mentor (if hiring committee accepts a conditional plan)
3) Candidate B

Recommendation: schedule a 20m calibration call at 10:00 PT to resolve the Mina/Marissa split on tolerance for design gaps. If after calibrating we still have split views, we'll escalate to the hiring committee with the conditional onboarding plan and a proposed first-90 day mentor.

Vote: please reply with one of {"hire", "hire-with-mentor", "no-hire"} by 09:30 PT so I can confirm the call agenda.

Attachment: arjun_verma_panel_summary.pdf

Karthik
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com, Sarah Huang <sarah@greenleaftalent.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0000
Subject: Final panel result: Arjun Verma — hire-with-mentor (confirmed)

Quick update for the panel and Sarah (recruiter):

We held a 20m calibration this morning and discussed the risk tradeoffs. Outcome: majority supported a conditional "hire-with-mentor" plan that mitigates Mina's design concerns with a named mentor and a 90-day checklist focused on consensus/replication patterns. Marissa acknowledged the operational strengths and Lauren reaffirmed the candidate's mentoring fit.

Final vote tally: Lauren = hire; Marissa = hire-with-mentor; Mina = no-hire; Karthik = hire-with-mentor. Final decision: hire-with-mentor.

Next steps for Sarah: please prepare an offer packet aligned to Senior Infra with a short paragraph in the offer email describing the 90-day mentorship checkpoints. We (recruiting + hiring lead) will own the mentor onboarding checklist.

Attachments: arjun_verma_panel_summary.pdf (pdf), arjun_verma_scorecards.zip (zip)

Thanks all — good work getting to consensus quickly.

Karthik
